title: DOE-02: GAO-25-107109 Recommendation 3 identity and agency response
summary: DOE-02 resolves one-to-one to GAO-25-107109 Recommendation 3; the record preserves the affected component, current GAO status, agency response, and last visible update period.
key_findings: Phase 56P action: DOE should develop complex-wide analyses that identify optimal waste-disposal strategies and alternatives.
Affected component: Department of Energy; Senior Advisor for Environmental Management.
Current GAO status: Open; status period: April 2026.
Agency response: DOE partially concurred in its 180-day letter and considered its action complete. GAO said the required complex-wide analysis was still missing.
Continuation rule: Recheck GAO-25-107109 Recommendation 3 when GAO changes the status or adds agency-response evidence after April 2026.
why_it_matters: The crosswalk replaces a letter-level local reference with an inspectable official report-and-recommendation identity where the evidence supports exactly one match.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves local action key DOE-02 as a crosswalk rather than an official identifier.
Separates official recommendation identity, affected entity, GAO status, agency response, implementation evidence, closure, and outcome.
Supports direct follow-through on GAO-25-107109 Recommendation 3.
evidence_limits: An agency response, concurrence, planned date, submission, or artifact under review does not by itself establish implementation or closure.
GAO recommendation status is not interchangeable with the Phase 56F entity evidence state.
Recommendation closure would not by itself establish operating performance, readiness, safety, value, or causation.
The official identity is the report number plus recommendation number shown on the GAO product page; FTFN does not invent a separate opaque database identifier.
